intent: A Skill may declare only the MCP tools the platform offers, and operators decide which tools those are.
observable_outcome: An mcp__ name in allowed-tools that no unretired mcp_tools row provides is blocked on a created draft or version and warned on an imported package; operators add and retire mcp_tools rows with a reason and an audit event.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Skill may declare in allowed-tools only MCP tools that operators list in mcp_tools, referenced as mcp__<server>__<tool>; an mcp__ name that no unretired mcp_tools row provides is unlisted, and a name without the mcp__ prefix is never judged against the list.

A created draft or created version of a Skill that declares in allowed-tools an mcp__ name no mcp_tools row offers is blocked with the finding mcp-tool-not-offered naming it and listing the offered references; an imported or uploaded package gets the same finding as a warning and is not blocked.
When the mcp_tools list cannot be read, the allowed-tools check of a package that declares an mcp__ name fails with an error and gives no verdict on the name, instead of passing the package.

An operator adds a row to mcp_tools with a server, tool, purpose, parameters, an HTTPS server_url and a reason, written in one transaction with its audit event; at most one unretired row exists per server and tool, and a second is refused as a conflict.

An operator retires an mcp_tools row with a non-blank reason, written with its audit event in one transaction; the row stays listed with its retirement reason, a blank reason is refused, and the retired row no longer occupies its server and tool.
